manifest_row.title: NZ firm promises solution to Tiwai Point

screening.main_topic: A proposed technology for making the Tiwai Point aluminium smelter more flexible in its electricity use and its potential effects on power supply, costs, and the smelter's future.
screening.climate_relevance: The article discusses how demand flexibility could reduce reliance on Huntly's coal-fired power units and cut emissions, framing this as a potential climate benefit of the technology.
